name: template-manifest
body: Template schema as data: a template's schema — one-line `description`, `usage: slide | section`, `fields` (name, type, required, default, limits, variants, formats/default format, description), `sections` (name, accepted section templates, min/max) and `body` rule — is declared in its `template.yaml`, not in Go code. The schema vocabulary is exactly the existing one (field-types, body-rules, template-composition, template-variants, number-date-formats). The template's example is `example.md`, parsed and validated like a deck slide (no hand-written structured example). AC: the former Go `builtinTemplates` definitions are expressible 1:1 in `template.yaml`, and no template schema remains in Go source.
